2493-5929-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2493-5929-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Leyline of Transformation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Archaeomancer token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2707-4872-6005.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, causing you to put Time Warp on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

654-1021-5413-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving Trenching Steed +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1021-1669-4826-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-3169-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3169-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

222-527-3499-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3499-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-3499-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

1245-1475-4419.notablePrerequisites: You control two additional creatures excluding the creature that has One with the Kami attached to it, at least one of which must be modified.
1245-1475-4419.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two other creatures.
When the creatures die, One with the Kami triggers for each modified creature that died this way, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens that each enter with a +1/+1 counter on them due to Renata.
Resolve the Tooth and Claw ability, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more oil counters on it

1018-1987-3120.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1018-1987-3120.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-3120.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-1902-7297.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1902-7297.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5195-5895-7634.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, targeting Practiced Scrollsmith.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Practiced Scrollsmith.
When Practiced Scrollsmith enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Splash Portal from exile by paying its mana cost, targeting Practiced Scrollsmith.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-5414-6662.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5414-6662.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

222-527-2921-6965.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2921-6965.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

454-1978-5168.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
454-1978-5168.description:
Cause Bloom Tender to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

850-1978-5517.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
850-1978-5517.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Overgrown Battlement.
Repeat

1170-1414-1492-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-1414-1492-6862.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1414-1492-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

586-2906-5258-5618-6797.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
586-2906-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4394-4452-5231-5470.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ghired, adding {R}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Ghired from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2060-2092-2445-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2092-2445-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

719-4508-5184-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1766-2608-4499.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat.

914-1879-3036.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1879-3036.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

2719-5231-5756.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, adding {R}.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

31-1068-1654-1940.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
Leveler enters the battlefield, exiling your library.
Cast Lokhust Heavy Destroyer by paying {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Lokhust Heavy Destroyer enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature, and you to sacrifice Lokhust Heavy Destroyer.
Lokhust Heavy Destroyer dies, triggering Liliana, causing you to return Lokhust Heavy Destroyer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

1350-3430-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{W}{U}.
1350-3430-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
